description: Lock a file to prevent editing by setting content restrictions. The file remains readable but cannot be modified until unlocked.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

fileId.description: ID of the file to lock

ownerRestricted.description: If true, only the file owner can unlock the file (default: false)

reason.description: Reason for locking the file (shown to users who try to edit)

name: lockFile
